feeds.title: Just Keep Swimming
feeds.description: I have decided to start this blog and write about my relationship with open water swimming as I continue my journey from there to wherever. I'm not one of those 'hardcore athletes' aiming to break records or swim super endurance distances. I am aiming to improve both my confidence and stamina in the sea, but I also want to explore ideas of 'community', 'well-being', 'transition' and 'journey'. Because it can sometimes be helpful to set a 'challenge goal' I have decided to aim to swim the South Coast of Britain - by the time I am 70 and to write about it as I make that journey.
